# Part 1: Checking the original distributions and how they varied

## 1.1 Distribution of parameters

Plot the distribution of scales for g(y). We see that they are nice and spread. 
<!-- TODO: Color the points by the general shapes of the distributions -->

```{r scales-g-y}
scales_g_y <- unique(detected_df$g_y1_scale)
plot(scales_g_y, type = "p", ylab = "scale", xlab = "sim", char = ".")
```

Plot the distributions of scales and shapes for g(theta). Same we want them nice and spread

```{r shapes-g-theta}
shapes_g_theta <- unique(detected_df$g_theta_shape)
plot(shapes_g_theta, type = "p", ylab = "scale", xlab = "sim", char = ".")
```

Plot the distributions of copula parameter rho for g(y, theta).

```{r copula-params}
copula_g_y_theta <- unique(detected_df$copula_rho)
plot(copula_g_y_theta, type = "p", ylab = "rho", xlab = "sim", char = ".")
```

### 2D bin of the three parameters
Visually it looks like we have enough combinations  of shapes, this part was just to confirm that the shapes used and assumed for the funcitons are actually very flexible

```{r 2d-bin}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)

data.frame(
  scales_g_y = scales_g_y,
  shapes_g_theta = shapes_g_theta,
  copula_g_y_theta = copula_g_y_theta
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = scales_g_y, y = shapes_g_theta, color = copula_g_y_theta)) +
  geom_point()
```

## 1.2 Visualization of distributions

We can futher confirm this by plotting a few of the example distributions for each component both the theorethical (using the parameters and the points), and empiricall using the observed marginal distribution
g(y) is a half normal — let's plot one for the sake of it.

The theorethical distribution based on the  scale parameter is showed in the 
```{r half-normal-g-y}
library(dplyr)

sims_to_sample <- sample(unique(detected_df$sim), 10, replace = FALSE)
# select the 
sims_to_sample = detected_df|> filter(realized_r_y > 0.7) |> pull(sim) |> sample(10)
length(sims_to_sample)
detected_df |> 
  filter(sim %in% sims_to_sample) |> 
  group_by(sim) |>
  mutate(pdf = dnorm(y, 0, unique(g_y1_scale))) |>
  mutate(pdf = (pdf[order(y)]-min(pdf))/(max(pdf)-min(pdf)), y_graph = y[order(y)], g_graph=g[order(y)]) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = y_graph, y = pdf, color=realized_r_y)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = detected_df |> filter(sim %in% sims_to_sample) |> group_by(sim) |> 
                mutate( y_graph = y[order(y)], g_graph=g[order(y)]) |>
                ungroup(),
    mapping = aes(x = y_graph, y = g_graph, color=realized_r_y)
  )+
  facet_wrap(~sim)# plot(NULL, xlim = c(0, 500), ylim = c(0, 0.07),
#      xlab = "y", ylab = "pdf", main = "g(y) half normal")
```
